mapper.select: SELECT mpdet.souce_code souceCode, mpdet.souce_type souceType, mpdet.souce_value souceValue, mpdet.dict_code dictCode, mpdet.f_det_id fDetId, mpdet.lev , concat_ws('',mpdet.dict_code,'-',Tmpdet.souce_value) detId FROM (SELECT mapping_id,souce_code,souce_type,souce_value,dict_code,f_det_id,"LEVEL" lev FROM STT_MAPPING_DET) mpdet INNER JOIN stt_mapping mp ON mpdet.mapping_id = mp.mapping_id WHERE mp.TGT_VALUE=#{tgtValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT group_concat(concat_ws('',dict_code,'-',item_code) order by linked_item_code separator ',') child, linked_dict_code pDictCode, trim(linked_item_code) pId FROM sys_datadict_list_link where 1=1 AND dict_code=#{dictCode} GROUP BY linked_item_code,linked_dict_code
